instruction: Put my things where they belong.

attempts.code:
go_home()
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_mug")
if not candidates:
    raise RuntimeError("No grasp candidates for yellow_mug")
candidate = candidates[0]
grasp(candidate)
if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp yellow_mug")

spots = free_spots("cyan_tray")
if not spots or not spots["spots"]:
    occupant = spots["occupants"][0]
    free_spots_purple = free_spots("purple_box")
    if not free_spots_purple or not free_spots_purple["spots"]:
        raise RuntimeError("No space to clear cyan_tray")
    spot = free_spots_purple["spots"][0]
    carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["gripper_yaw"])
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat()
    wait(20)

spots = free_spots("cyan_tray")
if not spots or not spots["spots"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Still no free spot on cyan_tray after clearing")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["gripper_yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
wait(20)

task_spec.refined_instruction: First, move the yellow_mug from the orange_tray to the cyan_tray. Before doing so, confirm that the cyan_tray is unoccupied; if not, clear it first. Then, move the blue_book from its current location (not on any zone) to the orange_tray, ensuring the orange_tray is clear before placement. After each move, verify that the object is correctly placed on its target zone. Success is achieved when the yellow_mug is on the cyan_tray and the blue_book is on the orange_tray, with no other objects on those zones.
